Findings: Verified semantic search covers decisions independently of the blackboard: decide() embeds into the 'decisions' index (src/engine/decisions.ts) and SearchEngine.searchDecisions loads it (src/embeddings/search.ts:132); ContextAssembler already used it (context-assembler.ts:108); twining_query previously reached decisions ONLY via their blackboard mirrors — post-#30 it calls DecisionEngine.searchDecisions directly, so overridden/superseded decisions are now also searchable (improvement); Backend note: the cross-post lived in the engine layer above the store interface, so the change is backend-agnostic; added an engine-over-sqlite-stores regression test in test/sqlite-backend.test.ts since engine suites don't parameterize backends; need: docs follow-up — plugin/BEHAVIORS.md:186,:642 and TWINING-DESIGN-SPEC.md:386,:722-728 still describe the cross-post; plugin/ edits need a version bump so left out of this change; Legacy mirrors on disk: no cleanup built per design; archive compaction (archive-35) could archive them later
